items.slide_topic: Fable 5.5 clips (credited by the poster, unverified): Tak's 'cool animation' style montage
items.author: Tak (@cherry_mx_reds)
items.caption: RE-CUT looping GIF (960x540, 20 fps, 139 frames, 6.95 s, 39.2 MB, per-frame 256-colour palettes, loops forever): the accelerating art-style montage, source 6.40-13.35 s of Tak's clip. Frame 0 is now the vivid risograph style ('STILL POINT PRESS - 3 COLOUR RISOGRAPH - ED. 55', yellow/red sun, halftone); it then cycles ~30 styles (low-poly vaporwave, Bauhaus, thermal camera, 8-bit, newspaper, Delft tile, X-ray, woodcut, blueprint, Starry-Night impasto, neon sign, ...) and settles on the line-art frame for ~0.55 s before looping back to the risograph.
items.notes: SUPERSEDES fable55/tak-fable55-still-point-style-montage-960.gif (38.4 MB, 134 frames, 6.7 s, 6.35-13.05 s), whose frame 0 was a single near-black ASCII-terminal frame (mean RGB 6,19,9; mostly black with thin green text) and which showed only 0.25 s of the line-art end frame. Same real footage, trimmed only (source: fable55/tak-fable55-cool-animation-1080p60-with-audio.mp4, ffmpeg fps=20, lanczos scale 960, palettegen stats_mode=single + paletteuse new=1 dither=sierra2_4a, gifsicle -O3, NO --colors so palettes stay per-frame). Checked: frame 0 fully opaque (no transparent pixels in any frame), 139 frames decode cleanly, loop count infinite, last-to-first seam difference (mean abs RGB 75.7) is smaller than the montage's own hard cuts (up to ~187), so the loop reads as one more cut. Silent GIF (the mp4 has the soundtrack). LibreOffice preview shows only frame 0, which is now the risograph still. Generated artwork text in the clip is not evidence of the model. Attribution is the poster's claim only: Anthropic has announced no 'Fable 5.5' (newest official: Claude Fable 5.1, Sep 1 2026; Opus 5.5, Sep 22; Sonnet 5.5, Sep 28). The post gives no tool, code, workflow or access details. Text inside the clip (e.g. 'Fable 5.5 画', 'ED. 55', 'Nº 5.5') is generated artwork, not evidence of which model made it.
